name: Path to Ascension: Novice Rider works for every race at its faction's riding trainers and from the book
contract: Tester reports: Garion Hunter (97921, Goldshire) teaches Novice Riding but offers no Novice Rider quest, the book's start button adds nothing, and a Night Elf who started in Dun Morogh gets no training from Ultham Ironhorn (4772) or Binjy Featherwhistle.

QuestSuperTrack.dbc sends every Alliance race's Novice Rider quest (Human 4420430, Night Elf 4420433) to Garion Hunter, Binjy Featherwhistle and Aalun, so a riding trainer teaches every race of its faction.

Expected: Garion shows a Human the available quest marker (8); Ultham offers a Night Elf riding training with Novice Riding (33379) available (0); the book's accept packet (zero giver GUID) adds 4420430, completed at once for a Human who already knows Novice Riding (quest status 1).

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Garion Hunter offers the Human the Novice Rider quest
His quest menu lists the Human Novice Rider quest
The Night Elf talks to Ultham Ironhorn
DISCRIMINATING: Ultham offers the Night Elf riding training
steps.text: I seek training to ride a steed.

steps.label: The Night Elf chooses riding training
Novice Riding is available to the Night Elf
The reader already knows Novice Riding
Start the Novice Rider quest from the book
DISCRIMINATING: the book adds the quest, already complete
